body: yeah i was banned for "suicide encouragement" today this friday when never in the past few months i never said anything suicide encouragement. my ign is Cordena and i was banned when i was offline by Jiveh. here was what i saw when i tried logging in today: https://gyazo.com/8b9875fe00c4a6f32f8fb7120e4514e0 the last time time i said kys was yesterday as a joke and said jk after with some friends but yeah. thank you for reading this and i hope you can unban me <3

replies.author: faht
replies.body:
Here is the evidence of you telling other users to commit suicide. Death threats are strictly not allowed, no matter if it was meant for a friend, or it was a joke. You and your friend maybe took it as a joke, but the rest of the players on the server you were playing on maybe got offended in some way. We simply do not allow this kind of stuff. I'll leave this appeal open for 24 hours incase you have something to say. For now, this appeal is denied.

Regards,
Jiveh

replies.body: I understand your pov and im not trying to be rude but that is complete bullshit. I was in a 3v3 game and all in it were knew i was joking and i doubt anybody would take offense if i said kys and said jk. nobody typed in chat/pm'd me that they were offended either. also, they said kys WITH jk's too so i dont understand why i am the only one banned... ive seen servers with policies stricter than this servers but not in death threats... i literally typed jk 1 second after and everybody in the game i was cool with.
